atoms.rule: Follow the hmode 9-phase SDLC, stored in protomcp. Read .project for the current phase; with no .project, ask whether this is a new project. Load the phase's rules before acting: store_get knowledge process:phase-<n>-<name> and process:phase-transitions, and search_standards 'critical rules' (core:critical-rules). No implementation code before Phase 8 unless the work is brownfield (after Phase 0) or a declared spike.

Before deciding how to do something in this repo, look in protomcp for guidance: search_standards (kind: gate for executable gates), search_tastes, search_knowledge and search_skills. Follow what it returns over your own defaults, and say which record you followed.
Record what lasts in protomcp, namespace promptly-aws: learnings, decisions and gotchas with upsert_knowledge, and tasks with upsert_issue (the user's exact words in context.verbatim).

Hooks create, update and close this session's record in protomcp (id cc-<session id>). Before you finish, add your work log to it with upsert_session on the same id: keep its name and description, put work done, decisions and follow-ups in context.log, and set issue_id or project_id when you know them.
Every aws CLI call names the account explicitly with --profile (or AWS_PROFILE=...); never rely on the default profile.
Never write a credential (AWS key, private key, GitHub/Anthropic/OpenAI/Slack token, hard-coded password) into a file; reference a declared secret instead.

tool.pre.check:
python3 - {command} <<'PY'
"""gate:aws-profile — every `aws` CLI call names a profile. argv: command. exit 0 pass, 1 fail, 3 n/a."""
import re, shlex, sys
GID = "gate:aws-profile"
cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
cmd = re.sub(r"\\\n", " ", cmd)  # a backslash-newline continues the same command
if not re.search(r"(^|[;&|(]\s*|\s)aws\s", " " + cmd):
    sys.exit(3)
bad = []
for seg in re.split(r"&&|\|\||;|\||\n", cmd):  # each line is its own command
    try:
        words = shlex.split(seg)
    except ValueError:
        words = seg.split()
    # strip leading VAR=value assignments
    i = 0
    env_profile = False
    while i < len(words) and re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=", words[i]):
        env_profile |= words[i].startswith("AWS_PROFILE=")
        i += 1
    if i < len(words) and words[i] == "aws":
        rest = words[i + 1:]
        if rest[:1] in (["configure"], ["--version"], ["help"]):
            continue
        if env_profile or "--profile" in rest or any(w.startswith("--profile=") for w in rest):
            continue
        bad.append(seg.strip())
if bad:
    for b in bad:
        print(f"{GID}: `{b[:120]}` has no --profile; name the account explicitly (hmode 7.1)")
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
PY

python3 - {content_path} <<'PY'
"""gate:secrets-in-writes — block a write whose new content holds a credential. argv: content_path. exit 0 pass, 1 fail, 3 n/a."""
import re, sys
GID = "gate:secrets-in-writes"
P = [
    (r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b", "AWS access key id"),
    (r"(?i)aws_secret_access_key\s*[=:]\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40}", "AWS secret access key"),
    (r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA |PGP )?PRIVATE KEY-----", "private key"),
    (r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}\b", "GitHub token"),
    (r"\bsk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", "Anthropic API key"),
    (r"\bsk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}\b", "OpenAI API key"),
    (r"\bxox[abpr]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}", "Slack token"),
    (r"(?i)\b(?:password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token)['\"]?\s*[=:]\s*['\"][^'\"\s$<{]{8,}['\"]", "hard-coded secret"),
]
if len(sys.argv) < 2 or not sys.argv[1]:
    sys.exit(3)
try:
    text = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
except OSError:
    sys.exit(3)
hits = []
for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
    for pat, what in P:
        if re.search(pat, line):
            hits.append(f"{GID}: line {i}: {what} (store it as a secret reference, e.g. ${{secrets.NAME}} or ssm:/path)")
            break
if hits:
    print("\n".join(hits[:10]))
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
PY
